entries.title: Asset-Based Finance
entries.description: Investments tied to asset-backed lending markets where financing is driven by collateral pools and contracted cash flows (e.g., receivables, consumer/merchant assets, hard assets).

entries.title: Consumer
entries.description: Investments tied to consumer-facing businesses and digital platforms, including commerce, marketplaces, and internet-enabled services.

entries.title: Direct Lending
entries.description: Investments tied to private credit markets—companies, sponsors, and ecosystems where direct corporate lending is the primary activity.

entries.title: Energy & Infrastructure
entries.description: Investments supporting energy production and delivery, renewable generation, and essential infrastructure assets and services.

entries.title: Growth
entries.description: Investments in growth-stage businesses and industries, focused on companies scaling products, markets, and revenues.

entries.title: Healthcare & Life Sciences
entries.description: Investments across healthcare services, life sciences, medical technology, and health-related infrastructure.

entries.title: Insurance
entries.description: Capital and investment solutions related to insurance businesses and/or insurance-linked balance sheets (e.g., partnering with insurers, reinsurers, or managing insurance-related assets).

entries.title: Real Estate
entries.description: Investments backed by real estate assets or platforms, including property-level and portfolio-level capital solutions.

entries.title: Software & Services
entries.description: Investments in software and software-enabled businesses, including enterprise platforms and recurring-revenue technology models.

entries.title: Sports, Media & Entertainment
entries.description: Investments in content, distribution, and media/entertainment businesses, including traditional and digital media platforms.
